model_claims.text: The change keeps the grouping of commented `from` imports stable across successive runs of isort.
model_claims.source_quote: Keep the grouping of commented `from` imports stable across runs

model_claims.text: On main, isort can change its output on a second run when a module’s `from` imports contain comments that cannot be combined into one statement.
model_claims.source_quote: With 10.0.0b2 and on `main`, isort can change its own output on the next run when the `from` imports of a module carry comments that cannot share one statement.

model_claims.text: Version 9.0.2 is not affected by the instability introduced in #2614.
model_claims.source_quote: 9.0.2 is not affected; this comes from the grouping added in #2614.

model_claims.text: After the change, names without a comment are placed in the first import statement and the grouping loop skips a conflicting name instead of stopping at it.
model_claims.source_quote: Names without a comment all go into the first statement. The loop skips a conflicting name instead of stopping at it.

model_claims.text: Each later statement contains a single commented name, keeping the comment attached to that name when it fits on one line.
model_claims.source_quote: Each later statement holds a single commented name, on one line when it fits, so the comment stays with that name.

model_claims.text: A `noqa` comment now remains with its associated name rather than being moved to the opening line of the statement.
model_claims.source_quote: This now also applies to a `noqa` comment, which a later statement used to move to its opening line when the module has a magic trailing comma.

model_claims.text: Comments added by `combine_as_imports` to the first statement are considered during grouping because they end up there anyway.
model_claims.source_quote: Comments that `combine_as_imports` adds to the first statement are taken into account while grouping, since they end up there anyway.

model_claims.text: With the branch applied, `isort --check` passes and `flake8 --select F401` reports no warnings on the sorted file.
With default settings, truststore's `_windows.py` changes on the second run, moving `# type: ignore[attr-defined]` onto `POINTER, Structure`.
model_claims.source_quote: - With default settings, truststore's `_windows.py` changed on the second run: `# type: ignore[attr-defined]` moved onto `POINTER, Structure`.

model_claims.text: With the black profile, pendulum's `helpers.py` changes on the second run.
model_claims.source_quote: - With the black profile, pendulum's `helpers.py` changed as well.

model_claims.text: With the branch, both files stay the same on a second run and no other file in the tested set shows different output compared to main.
model_claims.source_quote: - With this branch both files stay the same on the second run. With default settings and the black profile, no other file in that set gets different output than on `main`.

model_claims.text: The regression test in `tests/unit/test_regressions.py` fails on main.
Each part of the change is required: reverting any single piece causes the regression test to fail.
model_claims.source_quote: - Each of the three parts above is needed: reverting any single piece of the change makes one of its assertions fail.

model_claims.text: Running the core unit test suite yields 588 passed tests and 1 skipped, indicating no regressions.
model_claims.source_quote: `pytest tests/unit/test_isort.py tests/unit/test_regressions.py tests/unit/test_ticketed_features.py tests/unit/test_output.py tests/unit/test_parse.py tests/unit/test_comments.py tests/unit/test_wrap.py tests/unit/test_wrap_modes.py tests/unit/test_lazy_imports.py tests/unit/test_action_comments.py tests/unit/test_api.py tests/unit/test_literal.py tests/unit/profiles`: 588 passed, 1 skipped.

model_claims.text: Linting, formatting, and type‑checking tools report no issues after the change.
model_claims.source_quote: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `flake8`, `isort --profile hug --check`, `mypy` and `bandit` are clean.

model_claims.text: With the branch, only 108 of the 4,000 generated import blocks still change on a second sort, down from 1,337 on main.
model_claims.source_quote: The number that still changed on a second sort was 1,337 on `main`, 196 on 9.0.2 and 108 with this branch.

model_claims.text: All 108 blocks that still change with the branch also change on main.

items.about: Test stability and specific behaviors of isort with commented from imports

claims.text: The change keeps the grouping of commented `from` imports stable across successive runs of isort.
On main, isort can change its output on a second run when a module’s `from` imports contain comments that cannot be combined into one statement.
After the change, names without a comment are placed in the first import statement and the grouping loop skips a conflicting name instead of stopping at it.
Each later statement contains a single commented name, keeping the comment attached to that name when it fits on one line.
A `noqa` comment now remains with its associated name rather than being moved to the opening line of the statement.
With the branch applied, `isort --check` passes and `flake8 --select F401` reports no warnings on the sorted file.
